extraction.name: ArtifactsBench
extraction.description: A benchmark and automated, multimodal evaluation paradigm for visual code generation, comprising 1,825 diverse tasks across nine domains to evaluate LLMs on interactive visual artifacts.
extraction.creator: Tencent Hunyuan Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: We curate 1,825 tasks via a multi-stage pipeline combining expert sourcing with LLM generation and refinement. Tasks are sourced from expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots. Automated filters drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items, prioritizing dynamics (state changes, animations, responsiveness).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Document analysis, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection, Web Scraping
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Candidates aggregated from expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: De-duplication & contamination control: Two-stage filtering: (i) MinHash + semantic similarity over prompts, checklists, and normalized DOM/CSS/JS; (ii) screenshot perceptual hashing to catch visually near-identical artifacts. Flagged items are re-authored or discarded. Prompt rewriting & difficulty calibration: Experts rewrite for clarity/completeness/executability; LLM rewriting adds diverse styles; humans verify. Difficulty is assigned post hoc by aggregated performance of 30+ models to enforce 30%/40%/30% split; realized split 559/611/655. Sub-categories are tagged by a lightweight classifier with human spot-checks.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Sourcing & filtering: Automated filters drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items, prioritizing dynamics. Solvability validation & ambiguity repair: To ensure tasks are answerable and unambiguous, we collect candidate solutions from multiple families and prune underspecified items. Tasks solved only by brittle hacks (e.g., hard-coded coordinates that break under minor viewport changes) are revised or removed. We prefer prompts that admit multiple acceptable yet checkable implementations.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each query is paired with a 10-dimension checklist covering visual, interactional, and code qualities. We LLM-draft and then human-refine for specificity and screenability. A 10% manually curated seed anchors calibration and achieves Cohen’s κ ≥ 0.8 among annotators; the seed is reused as few-shot references to keep difficulty high and rubrics consistent. The 10 items are grouped into five vision-oriented and five code-oriented dimensions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: A 10% manually curated seed anchors calibration and achieves Cohen’s κ ≥ 0.8 among annotators. Human validation: We run a double-blind study on 280 queries and 6 models, judged by multiple front-end engineers. Agreement is measured by Pair ACC.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Multimodal LLM (MLLM)-as-Judge (Gemini-2.5-Pro and Qwen2.5-VL-72B), Hunyuan-Turbos for checklist generation.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: We release dataset specs, checklist templates, evaluation scripts, and referee settings; future work targets richer dynamics beyond discrete screenshots, agentic multi-turn self-debugging, and broader artifact domains.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The benchmark addresses a critical evaluation gap in visual fidelity and interactive integrity for modern user experiences, aiming to accelerate the development of user-centric generative models.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Limitations include: discrete screenshot sampling may not fully capture complex, long-horizon, or state-dependent interactions; does not assess LLM's capability for agentic, iterative development based on feedback; focuses on single-turn generation rather than multi-step development processes.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Dataset use cases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning for evaluating LLMs on interactive visual artifacts. Usage Guidelines: Tasks are stratified into Easy/Medium/Hard tiers for discriminative evaluation; supports fine-grained capability analysis across nine domains.
